messages:
maya: RFC follow-up: propose a compact intent facade between console and query. goals: smaller payloads, push RBAC preflight, cheaper canaries. initial thoughts?

alex: Nice. How does panel projection and dynamic filters fit?

maya: Console emits an intent proto (route, tenant, projection set, hints) instead of full graph. Facade runs auth preflight, expands only allowed projection nodes. Heavy/complex queries go to legacy endpoint.

kevin: Proto size vs current? CPU vs network tradeoff?

maya: Bench: full graph ~1.7KB, intent ~200B. Parse at edge drops ~10ms. Enables compact cache keys.

zoe: We need a canonical projection grammar so OPA policies are deterministic. Propose minimal DSL for projections+filters.

alex: Agree. Also need intent versioning and fallback behavior for unknown versions.

maya: Plan: X-Intent-Version header; facade returns 412 for unknown -> console falls back to legacy. Keep two versions for 3 months.

kevin: Rollout: behind flag, shadow legacy for 5% traffic, enable strict preflight only on canary, monitor latencies and auth_mismatch_count.

zoe: Add metrics: facade_expansion_failures, intent_cache_hit_ratio, percent_heavy_queries, and audit log for legacy-escapes. Batch OPA checks per-tenant to avoid storming.

maya: Add small LRU auth cache keyed by (tenant,route,proj-hash) TTL 30s and invalidate on role-change webhook. Tests will include legacy vs facade output diffs.

infra-bot: CI note: integration-tests/console-facade failing on staging (auth-suite). https://ci.redwood.internal/12345

kevin: Likely role-change invalidation. Maya, please add webhook in test harness.

maya: Will push patch and RFC doc with grammar & mapping table this afternoon.
